response: Ward D (Grant Road, Malabar Hill, Tardeo) has billed Rs 1272300 of its Rs 1600000 monsoon repair budget, which is 79.5 percent, across 40 jobs. Of these jobs, 20.0 percent were reopened within 30 days and 55.0 percent met the promised repair time, so repair quality needs review. For context, the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, and the ward's low lying index is 0.4. Rs 525710 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs there should cost the city nothing. These bills should be checked. One job was priced more than 30 percent above the rate card. The top contractor by spend is Sahyadri Infra Works (synthetic). A citizen or ward officer can ask the ward office whether work order WO25-00519 was on a DLP road and, if so, why the city paid for it.
